units.source_text: 到了十月里，皇上即将行幸朱雀院离宫。

en.t: In the tenth month, the Emperor was soon to make an imperial visit to the Suzaku-in detached palace.

units.source_text: 当天舞乐中的舞人，都选用侯门子弟、公卿及殿上人中长于此道之人。

en.t: For the dancers in the music and dances that day, sons of noble houses, court nobles, and courtiers skilled in the art were all chosen.

units.source_text: 故自亲王、大臣以下，无不忙于演习，目不暇给。

en.t: Thus everyone from the princes and ministers on down was busy rehearsing, with more activity than the eye could take in.
Prince Genji too was busy with rehearsals.

units.source_text: 忽然想起了迁居北山僧寺的老尼姑，许久不曾通信，便特地遣使前去问候。

en.t: Suddenly he remembered the old nun who had moved to a temple in Kitayama, and since he had not written to her for a long time, he specially sent a messenger to inquire after her.

units.source_text: 使者带回来的只有僧都的信，信中说道：

en.t: The messenger brought back only a letter from the bishop, which said:
My younger sister at last passed away on the twentieth day of last month.

units.source_text: 会者必离，生者必灭，固属人世之常道。

en.t: Those who meet must part, and those who live must perish; this is indeed the ordinary way of the human world.
Even so, it is deeply sorrowful and worthy of mourning.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了此信，痛感人生之无常。

en.t: When Prince Genji read this letter, he keenly felt the impermanence of human life.

units.source_text: 他想起老尼姑所悬念的那个女孩，不知怎么样了。

en.t: He thought of the girl about whom the old nun had been so concerned, wondering how she was now.

units.source_text: 孤苦无依，定然恋念这已死的外祖母吧。

en.t: Left lonely and without support, she must surely be longing for her dead grandmother.

units.source_text: 他和自己的母亲桐壶更衣永别时的情状，虽然记忆不清，还可隐约回想。

en.t: Although his memories were unclear, he could still faintly recall the circumstances of his final parting from his own mother, the Kiritsubo Consort.

units.source_text: 因此他对这紫儿十分同情，诚恳地遣使吊唁。

en.t: For that reason he felt deep sympathy for this little Murasaki, and sincerely sent a messenger to offer condolences.
Shonagon, her nurse, replied with thanks according to proper form.
